verdict.rationale: Plausible documents HTTP APIs: the Stats API with a POST /api/v2/query endpoint, and the Events API. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples. Probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger spec all returned 404, so there is no machine-readable spec that would typically power an interactive explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
